intent.proves: At least one active default-type user may sign in to the backend, directly or through a direct group.
intent.scope: active AccessUser rows of type Default (5); backend access set on the user or on a group it is directly in (inheritance through parent groups not counted, so the count is a lower bound)

bindings.reason: UserModel backend-access projection not available to mcp-count.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser u WHERE u.AccessUserType = 5 AND u.AccessUserActive = 1 AND (u.AccessUserAllowBackend = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccessUserGroupRelation r JOIN AccessUser g ON g.AccessUserId = r.AccessUserGroupRelationGroupId WHERE r.AccessUserGroupRelationUserId = u.AccessUserId AND g.AccessUserAllowBackend = 1))
